keep_features.feature_value: High density of political figure/org mentions
keep_features.rationale: Multiple @mentions of organizations and prominent politicians appear in a single post.

keep_features.evidence_span: Immigration reform should be a path to USA Citizenship
keep_features.rationale: The text explicitly argues about immigration reform and obtaining citizenship.
Uses profanity and explicit sexual slang in the argument.

keep_features.evidence_span: you're just interested in cooming. Very feminist.
keep_features.rationale: The speaker discredits a viewpoint by attributing it to sexual motives and dismisses it.

keep_features.evidence_span: they still couldn’t see he’s a clown.
keep_features.rationale: Uses sustained mockery to express contempt for the political figure.

keep_features.feature_value: Reproductive health vs. life values with endorsements and hashtags
keep_features.evidence_span: Planned Parenthood ... #a2council ... Sexual & Reproductive Health Champion
keep_features.rationale: The post frames a values/identity debate around reproductive health and cites a specific council endorsement/hashtag.

keep_features.feature_value: Gendered moral/legitimacy claim about who should legislate
keep_features.evidence_span: This is why men shouldn't be legislating women's reproductive health.
keep_features.rationale: Makes a prescriptive normative statement about political authority and legislation.

keep_features.feature_value: Metaphor labels a political bloc as a disease/disorder
keep_features.evidence_span: A friend of mine describes MAGA as a sickness.
keep_features.rationale: Assigns a dehumanizing/medicalized label to a partisan group.

remove_features.feature_value: Quotation-based taunt with slur-like framing and informal stance
remove_features.evidence_span: stupid libs... fuck them anyways I love when these people are mad
remove_features.rationale: Contains slang/insulting rhetoric and profane dismissal presented in a quoted style.

remove_features.evidence_span: SHOULD have been enough... NO MORALS, NO VALUES
remove_features.rationale: Uses strong capitalization and dense emphatic language typical of inflammatory rhetoric.

remove_features.evidence_span: Baby raping SHOULD have been enough
remove_features.rationale: Mentions a sexual-violence act as justification for political condemnation.

remove_features.feature_value: Degrading insult toward outgroup plus exaggerated scenario
remove_features.evidence_span: douchebag ... poorly trained racist, violent moron... and you have ICE.
remove_features.rationale: Uses mockery and demeaning labels to discredit a political/governance actor.

remove_features.feature_value: Death of a security guard framed as victimization tied to hatred
remove_features.evidence_span: security guard killed protecting children... WOULD be alive if it weren’t for the hatred against Muslims
remove_features.rationale: Attributes a death to persecution/hatred and frames the person as a victim.

remove_features.feature_value: Accountability call for law/police and deportation framing
remove_features.rationale: Directly calls for a punitive/accountability action.

remove_features.feature_value: Uses explicit slogan with emphatic exclamation
remove_features.evidence_span: I believe in fucking and the second amendment!
remove_features.rationale: Strong direct exhortation/slogan style with taboo language.

remove_features.feature_value: Claims actions are an intentional evasive strategy ('easy answer' to avoid fixing systemic issues)
remove_features.evidence_span: Immigration is the easy answer where they don't actually have fix any of the systemic issues
remove_features.rationale: Suggests deliberate avoidance of underlying problems rather than addressing them directly.
